chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 338: Anomaly - Qu Hun Goes Rogue
chapter_meta_description: Han Li returns to check on his assets, only to discover his most powerful puppet, Qu Hun, has become self-aware and escaped. A forbidden anomaly threatens to unravel his plans.
og_description: The reanimated corpse Han Li created has developed a mind of its own. The ‘Soul Summoning Bell’ is useless, and a feral monster now roams the mountains.
twitter_title: RMJI 338: Anomaly – The Walking Corpse Speaks!
twitter_description: A forbidden alchemical creation evolves beyond its master’s control. Qu Hun is now a wild card in Han Li’s game.

lore_anchors.definition: A ritual artifact used to bind or command soulless bodies. Despite its unremarkable appearance, it functions as a spiritual tether between master and servant.
A diagnostic or perception technique used by cultivators to reveal hidden physical or energetic phenomena, such as poison flowing in the blood.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Han Li just kill Sun Ergou?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Sun Ergou is a useful mortal asset who manages the local underworld and logistics. Killing him would be a waste of a perfectly functional tool. Han Li prefers to maintain control through fear and calculated generosity, not wanton destruction.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Qu Hun’s self-awareness such a big deal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Qu Hun was created as a soulless puppet through forbidden corpse refinement arts. For a husk with no sentient soul to develop self-awareness, speech, and independent movement is an extreme anomaly that defies the basic laws of life and death in this universe. It suggests a dangerous new variable has entered the equation.
